Only Mathematical Induction is held, for the Q37/Q38 crop. Sets Q1=B Q2=D, Complex Numbers Q1=B Q2=D. No conflict issues (key table and solutions agree). 0 unresolved pages. minor.issue: Titles that start with a digit are rejected. Both checks fail: `not v[:1].isupper()` for '3D Geometry – Solutions' and `re.match(r'^\d', title)` for 'Answer key – 3D Geometry'. So chapter_headings returns no marks on page 478, and the Chapter 25 (3D Geometry) key table is read as instructions (key=0). Answers still come from the solutions ('N. Answer: (X)'), so the mock is ready, but the key is not cross-checked for this chapter. Fix: accept a digit-led title when it matches a known chapter title in chapter_info or the plan (e.g. norm(title) equals norm(record.title)), and keep rejecting other digit-led titles.

Relabel is by name: norm(old label) -> bookmark label. The v3 printed-heading reader merged Logarithms, 3D Geometry and Mathematical Modelling into the chapter before them. So a kept owner_repair or ai_proposal page from one of those chapters (old label 'Quadratic Equations', 'Vectors' or 'Linear Programming') is moved to the WRONG chapter. Reproduced with page 61: Chapter 3 is held for duplicate questions and Chapter 4 is held with 14 questions and 'no matching question'. Fix: relabel by page position, i.e. the plan chapter whose page range contains the page (the last plan entry with page <= n). Use the name only as a check, or when the ranges agree.

critical_code_review_comments: relabel_kept is O(pages) with one update per page, and it also rewrites pages that have no old label. Acceptable, but it could filter to rows whose labels change.
relabel_kept sets context.plan=True on kept pages. Fine for read_batch, which only takes context from existing pages.

chapter_headings in plan mode filters marks with m['label']==context['mock'], so a printed heading for the next chapter on the last page is ignored. That is intended, but a bookmark plan that is off by one page will drop the key table silently with no issue raised.
